project.title: Somebody's Gotta Do It
project.energy: playful everyday absurdity escalating into aggressive club chaos

spoken.delivery: confident, mischievous, rhythmic, conversational; increasingly unhinged

sung.use_for_this_track: limited; optional pitched texture or chant layer only

production.bass: rubbery, syncopated, dirty, heavy, deliberately wonky
production.drums: club kick, sharp clap/snare, metallic/glitch percussion, fills and abrupt dropouts
production.arrangement_rule: keep the lyric phrasing intelligible; make the production progressively more chaotic
production.rights: original lyrics; use only original or appropriately licensed sound assets

sections.name: intro_tag
sections.delivery: whispered repetitions; final line dry and up-front

sections.name: verse_1
sections.delivery: fast conversational spoken lead; sparse beat; ad-lib answers

sections.name: pre
sections.delivery: build urgency; overlapping voices; stop before drop

sections.name: chorus
sections.delivery: gang-shouted hook; hard rhythmic vocal chops

sections.name: verse_2
sections.delivery: spoken lead; denser bass and interruptions

sections.name: final_chorus_outro
sections.delivery: maximum layers; abrupt beat cut for final spoken tag

fx: short delay throws at phrase ends
alternating dry and distorted response voices
